channel.title: Journal, Indigibilli Harshit
channel.description: Things I built, places I learned, and the people who helped along the way.

item.title: The POC that became six months at IIT Delhi
item.description: How a proof of concept for Prof. Manabendra Saharia turned into a six-month research internship at HydroSense Lab, IIT Delhi.

item.title: From a roadside question to IEEE Xplore
item.description: The story behind RHPA, an AI and IoT system for preventing wildlife road accidents, published in IEEE Xplore at ESIC 2026.

item.title: Notes from Day 1 at the IndiaAI Summit
item.description: Day 1 at the IndiaAI Summit: startup stalls, ideas that had already become real products, and conversations with the people building them.

item.title: Pokémon GO for engineers: collecting 70 GB of invisible signals
item.description: Collecting 70+ GB of RF data with software defined radio and training deep learning models for RF fingerprint identification at NIT Rourkela.

item.title: Waitlist 1: the "almost" that shaped my research journey
item.description: Waitlisted at IIT Gandhinagar, then selected for the Summer Research Internship at NIT Rourkela: what asking for feedback after a rejection taught me.

item.title: How a question about roadkill won the IBM ICE Ideathon
item.description: RHPA uses DenseNet, ResNet and YOLOv5xu to detect animals near roads and alert drivers. It won the IBM ICE Ideathon 2025.

item.title: Teaching robotics, and making the morning paper
item.description: A robotics workshop at Rajadhani College, Bhubaneswar, featuring the reconfigurable Smorphi robot and covered by The Daily Pioneer.

item.title: Eco-Yatra and a weekend at the WATCH Hackathon
item.description: Eco-Yatra, a carbon-tracking sustainable travel app, won first place in the Sustainable Cities theme at the WATCH Hackathon 2024.

item.title: What I learned presenting data-driven drug discovery
item.description: A technical paper on data-driven drug discovery and an ML prototype for personalised suggestions, presented at IBM ICE Day 2024.
